error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, please check your settings.
error.invalid_model: Invalid or unknown inverter model. Please select a model from the list.
error.tcp_port_closed: Nothing is accepting Modbus connections on that address and port. The device may be reachable (it answers ping) but not serving Modbus — check that Modbus TCP is enabled on the datalogger. Recent Solis logger firmware is known to close local port 502; an RS485-to-TCP bridge is a workaround.
error.poll_interval_below_floor: Fast poll interval is below the minimum for the selected poll profile. Only the extreme profile allows intervals below 10s (minimum 2s).

solis_write_holding_register.name: Write holding register
solis_write_holding_register.description: Writes a value to a holding register

host.name: Inverter
host.description: Inverter IP (only required if you have multiple inverters)

solis_write_time.name: Change the time of a entity
solis_write_time.description: Sets the time of the entity to the provided one

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Entity ID of the time entity you want to change

solis_read_register.name: Read register
solis_read_register.description: Reads one or more registers and returns the raw values (register discovery / debugging)

solis_force_battery_charge.name: Force battery charge
solis_force_battery_charge.description: Force the battery to charge (hybrid inverters); reverts after the timeout

solis_force_battery_discharge.name: Force battery discharge
solis_force_battery_discharge.description: Force the battery to discharge (hybrid inverters); reverts after the timeout

solis_stop_force_charge_discharge.name: Stop force charge/discharge
solis_stop_force_charge_discharge.description: Cancel an active force charge or discharge

solis_dispatch.name: Remote dispatch
solis_dispatch.description: Real-time inverter dispatch: goal-seeking grid/battery control with inverter-side failsafe

solis_dispatch_stop.name: Stop remote dispatch
solis_dispatch_stop.description: Release dispatch — the inverter returns to normal operation immediately

solis_dispatch_schedule.name: Program dispatch schedule period
solis_dispatch_schedule.description: Write one of six inverter-resident scheduled dispatch periods (survives HA restarts)

datalogger_unreachable.title: Solis datalogger unreachable
datalogger_unreachable.description: No successful Modbus read from {host} since {last_success}. The WiFi datalogger may be asleep, powered off or in a half-open state; the integration keeps retrying with backoff. Power-cycle the datalogger if this persists.
